title: Project-graph document (what the orchestrator reads)
description: The tracker-neutral document `scripts/derive` emits and the §2.6 orchestrator consumes. The orchestrator reads ONLY the derived sections and node tags; it MUST NOT re-derive blocking, ranking, or cycle detection. Serialization is JSON here; §2.6 leaves it implementation-defined provided producer and orchestrator agree.

cursor.description: The latest opaque sync cursor. The orchestrator persists this and passes it back on the next delta.

nodes.description: Per-ticket tags. The orchestrator may read these but schedules off the derived sections below.

available.description: Ranked frontier of unblocked, non-excluded, non-human tickets with target_kind pr|verification, eligible to be picked up. Injected ids are forced to the head. Order is the dispatch order.

blocked.description: Startable-role tickets effectively-blocked by an unresolved ancestor or an unreviewed milestone gate; expected to unblock as ancestors resolve.

human-blocked.description: Tickets parked pending a human: human_interactive signal, or a worker-discovered park (role awaiting-external/paused).

permanently-blocked.description: Tickets that can never become available: themselves dead (terminated_without_verify, not canceled) or gated behind such a dead ancestor. A canceled ancestor never places a dependent here.

ready_for_review.description: Guarded value: forced false while the milestone has unresolved work.

review_recorded.description: Guarded value: forced false whenever ready_for_review is false. When ready_for_review AND NOT review_recorded, the orchestrator dispatches a milestone-review agent.

complete.description: Derived: every ticket in the milestone is verified/canceled/dead.

counts.description: Per-project and per-milestone tallies. `all_terminal` drives §2.6 completion.

all_terminal.description: True when every project's remaining count is 0 — the §2.6 completion signal.

anomalies.description: Cycles (severity: illegal per §2.3 — surface, never work around) and cross-project dependency edges (surfaced for awareness). The orchestrator MUST surface these and MUST NOT silently proceed past a cycle.
